title: Secure first confirmed adopting/citing/requesting partner
context: The Elyos 'delivered, not merged' bar requires at least one named partner/steward that has adopted, hosted, cited, or formally requested a reanalysis. Without a confirmed steward, the project cannot declare itself shipped even if all technical work is complete. The outreach thread started in outreach-007 must now convert into a concrete commitment. Once a steward is confirmed, tasks for that beneficiary are updated to verifiedNeed: true and requestor is set.
objective: Convert the outreach threads from outreach-007 into a confirmed commitment from at least one named partner (dataset author, curator, reproducibility initiative, PRIDE team, nf-core/proteomics, or equivalent) to adopt, host, cite, or formally request a reanalysis.
acceptanceCriteria: A named dataset author, curator, reproducibility initiative, or community organization confirms in writing that they will adopt, host, cite, or has formally requested a specific reanalysis from this project.
The steward's name, organization, and commitment type (adopt/host/cite/request) are recorded in a committed document.
Tasks associated with that beneficiary's specific reanalysis are updated to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set to the confirmed individual/organization.
The steward confirmation document is licensed CC-BY-4.0 and committed to the project repo.
resources: PLAN.md — Verified need, Partner org section
output: A committed document recording the confirmed partner/steward commitment, with associated task verifiedNeed and requestor fields updated; licensed CC-BY-4.0.
